title: ExtractionResponse
description: Response envelope returned by Person 1's /extract endpoint. Wraps GraphData with status and per-field confidence so the frontend can trigger the confirmation/correction flow instead of trusting extraction silently.

status.description: ok: safe to show without warning. low_confidence: show confirmation/correction UI before Overview. error: extraction failed, prompt retake/upload.

graph.description: Present when status is ok or low_confidence; null when status is error. Shape defined in graph-data.schema.json.

fieldConfidence.description: Per-field confidence (0-1) for graphType, title, xAxis, yAxis, series, used to highlight which specific fields need user confirmation.

message.description: Human-readable reason for low_confidence or error status, e.g. 'y-axis unit unreadable' or 'no chart detected in image'.
